description: Phase 3b gate — multi-page tables on the on-disk backend. Covers first-split (leaf-to-interior promotion), subsequent leaf splits under the same interior root, multi-leaf scans, cross-page UPDATE in-place, cross-page DELETE tombstones surviving reopen, and interior-full STORAGE_PAGE_FULL (at ~270k rows for default 4096-byte pages). Memory-backend semantics unchanged. All phase1..3a fixtures must stay green. Cross-build equivalence between C and Rust is required.

schema.case: inherits phase3a.json schema plus three new step kinds:

bulk_insert_int_range_step.behavior: For i in [start, start+count), the harness tokenize/parse/compile/run `INSERT INTO <table> VALUES (<i>);` as if it were a separate SQL step. Any individual failure aborts the batch and reports the failure as this step.

select_rows_int_range_step.behavior: Compares actual rows against the generated sequence [[start], [start+1], ..., [start+count-1]]. Each row has exactly one column (integer).

select_row_count_step.behavior: Runs the SELECT and asserts the row count only (not row contents). Used for large scans where enumerating contents bloats JSON.

cases.name: disk-single-page-still-works
cases.description: Phase 3a single-page path continues to work under the new code path.

cases.name: disk-first-split-triggers-interior-root
cases.description: Insert enough tiny-row entries to cross the single-leaf threshold, forcing the first split. After the split the table's root is an interior page with two leaf children.

cases.name: disk-split-survives-reopen
cases.description: After first split, close and reopen. All 1000 rows must come back in order, confirming interior pages round-trip correctly through disk.

cases.name: disk-many-leaves-one-interior
cases.description: ~5000 rows produces a 2-level tree with many leaves. Verify all rows are returned and counted.

cases.name: disk-delete-across-pages
cases.description: Delete rows from the middle of a multi-leaf tree. Tombstones on interior leaves must be invisible to subsequent SELECTs.

cases.name: disk-update-in-place-cross-page
cases.description: UPDATE a row in a non-root leaf. Same-width replacement fits in place (no split). After UPDATE, SELECT sees new value.

program.sql: UPDATE t SET x = 99999 WHERE x = 250;
SELECT x FROM t WHERE x = 99999;
SELECT x FROM t WHERE x = 99999;

cases.name: disk-multiple-tables-all-split
cases.description: Two tables both cross the split boundary. Their root pages stay stable (sqlite_schema.rootpage invariant). Both survive reopen.

cases.name: disk-interior-stays-stable-across-many-splits
cases.description: Insert 3000 rows in 3 batches with reopens between. Tree grows through multiple leaf splits; root-page number must remain stable.
